description: Defines functions related to FIPS service indicators, including update, lock, unlock, and verification functions, with conditional implementations based on FIPS build configuration.

methods.name: FIPS_service_indicator_update_state
methods.description: Records that an approved service has been invoked; implementation varies based on FIPS build.

methods.name: FIPS_service_indicator_lock_state
methods.description: Locks the service indicator state to prevent updates; nesting supported.

methods.name: ECDH_verify_service_indicator

methods.name: EVP_Cipher_verify_service_indicator
